hooks.name: Synchronize AI Character Artifacts
hooks.description: Reviews agent-made AI character source changes against the feature specification and updates only the durable artifact that must change.

action.prompt: Review this saved AI virtual character related source change against `.kiro/specs/ai-virtual-character/`. Update requirements.md only when a deliberate user-visible behavior changed; update design.md when architecture, contracts, persistence, error handling, privacy, or data flow changed; update tasks.md when scope, dependencies, or completion state changed. Promote a rule to steering only if it is stable and applies across features. Do not add one-off implementation details to steering and do not modify unrelated specs.
